study.question: Can task-selective access to two count-preserving history summaries retain the click advantage of uniform compression and the auxiliary-feedback advantage of stratification, using a single target/action scorer and fewer scorer positions than full-history DIN?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g2-r0000-uniform10 has click AUC 0.6575705899 and auxiliary mean AUC 0.8542524200, whereas g2-r0001-feedback_action has click AUC 0.6560597566 and auxiliary mean AUC 0.8645433848. In the previous matched factorial, true feedback membership loses click against rotated membership with and without action-conditioned scoring (-0.0005844788 and -0.0002064413), but improves auxiliary mean (+0.0123178130 and +0.0078058234). These are single-seed observations, not repeated mechanism support. Uniform means may regularize the click readout, while auxiliary predictions benefit from retaining action/item association in separate strata. A task-conditioned compression readout may accommodate that disagreement through shared target-aware parameters. This does not assume gradient conflicts have been measured.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text read at lines 56-155 and 285-374. Inherit target-conditioned local activation, Dice and pooled-history readout from the local adapted reference. Add two explicit compression views before that scorer and route them by prediction task. This is not an exact reproduction of the original DIN training recipe.

Pinned primary benchmark source lines 123-170 initializes a distinct masked sequence hub per task and updates task/categorical/sequence representations through hub aggregation and broadcasts. Here the cart/fav/buy mask union only defines two strata per temporal block; one scorer is shared, with fixed task-to-summary access and no learned task hubs, separate per-task sequence projections or broadcasts. Original paper:infnet is link-only in this authorized source bundle; original-method equivalence and novelty remain unverified.

Pinned forward lines 127-158 and benchmark section 2.3 inspected. Group compression is a nearby design family, but this candidate uses arithmetic masked means rather than inner Transformers or recent-query attention. It preserves all authorized 100 history positions and introduces task-specific choice of summary, not a longer input. Original paper:longer remains unaudited.

Section 2.3 provides the scoped taxonomy and benchmark method descriptions. The present proposal is a stacked compression/readout adaptation, not a claim to introduce task-aware interaction or group compression in general.

inherited_components: Frozen data identities, released 100-position prefix, official_offline feedback visibility, four labels, full validation population, host seed and complete training recipe.
Width-16 FeatureEmbeddingDict and user/context, target item fields, historical item/action concatenation from baseline-din and the successful round-1 modules.
g2-r0000-uniform10 count-preserving contiguous ten-block means and g2-r0001-feedback_action auxiliary-union versus complement means.
Action-aware DIN scorer shapes and initialization order, four separate [128,64] Dice towers, and default summed four unweighted BCE losses from g2-r0001-feedback_action.
Explicit rejection of missing historical masks, auxiliary mask intersected with the history mask, and exclusion of current target action.
study.proposed_difference: Construct per block three slots: uniform, nonauxiliary, auxiliary. Independently normalize each mean and multiply its final activation by its valid count. Score all 30 slots together through ONE common target/item/action local activation. Sum uniform slots into U and both feedback strata into F. A fixed two-character route selects U or F for click and, independently, the three auxiliary towers. Candidate UF uses U for click and F for auxiliaries; UU, FF and FU complete the 2x2 factorial. Every cell computes both views, has identical parameter shapes/initialization order and the same Dice slot population, and differs only in head access. No new learned gate, tower width, task weight or optimizer change is introduced. This is a new local information-flow experiment; originality and benefit remain unverified.
predictions: Primary preregistered contrast: switching auxiliary routing U->F at fixed click routing U (UF minus UU) should improve auxiliary mean AUC. Switching click routing F->U at fixed auxiliary routing F (UF minus FF) should improve click AUC. Inspect both metrics in every contrast, because shared parameters transmit effects between tasks.

A direction is worth repetition if UF improves auxiliary mean over UU by at least 0.002 and improves click over FF by at least 0.0002. These are practical screening thresholds, not significance levels. If only one criterion holds, label the corresponding component provisionally supported rather than claiming joint retention.

For the intended quality tradeoff, UF should reach click AUC within 0.0002 of the existing incumbent 0.6575705899471084, with auxiliary mean at least 0.005 above its 0.8542524199595748. Only click AUC selects the best model; retain the incumbent whenever its click AUC remains higher. These cross-round targets cannot establish attribution.

Analyze factorial main effects for click routing: ((UF-FF)+(UU-FU))/2; auxiliary routing: ((UF-UU)+(FF-FU))/2; and interaction UF-UU-FF+FU for click AUC, every auxiliary AUC and auxiliary mean. The complementary simple effects must be reported, including reversals. Do not treat four cells as independent seeds.

Each branch should preserve total valid event count; with constant local activation either branch recovers the same masked event sum. Empty history yields zero pooled history, and masked IDs/actions or unknown current action cannot contribute to either view. These are algebraic requirements pending host tensor checks, not executed torch results.

The new suite scores 30 rather than 100 positions per example, with the same number of parameters as the round-1 action-aware scorer (expected 32,060,453 total; host measurement required). A lower p95 model latency and peak memory than baseline-din would support implementation efficiency. No speedup over uniform10 is predicted; added view computation may worsen that frontier.

Report the four fixed history-length slices (empty,1-16,17-64,>64), with samples/positives/negatives, all task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean, parameters, measured train/wall cost, throughput and p50/p95 latency. Empty-history changes after training are parameter-sharing effects, not retained history information. Existing slice patterns are exploratory; do not invent unavailable composition/frequency diagnostics.
falsifiers: UF fails the two practical matched-contrast criteria: no support for the proposed joint retention mechanism in this implementation. Preserve the failed or partial trajectory and distinguish loss of auxiliary signal from loss of click performance.
FU equals or improves both target metrics over UF, or UU dominates UF: task-aligned access is unsupported. A win over the old DIN reference alone cannot establish this mechanism.

A gain exists only relative to old uniform10 or old feedback_action but not new matched UU/FF: changed action-conditioned scorer, mixed Dice population or training stochasticity remain sufficient explanations.
AUC gains coupled to poorer Logloss must be reported as a discrimination/calibration tradeoff. Auxiliary gains cannot substitute for click-based model selection.

Host forward/backward checks fail, logits/probabilities are nonfinite, padded-event perturbation or target-action perturbation changes evaluation predictions, or either view fails count conservation: implementation is invalid; retain charged failure and repair before interpretation.

Latency, peak memory or full-unit allocated/wall cost is not improved relative to full DIN: no measured efficiency claim for this implementation. Thirty scorer slots alone do not establish end-to-end savings.
Follow-up paired seeds reverse the key contrasts: downgrade preliminary support; no significance or repeated-support claim from this initial single-seed suite.
alternative_explanations: Shared embeddings and scorer gradients change when a task is routed differently. This suite identifies the total effect of task access, not a clean decomposition into retained information and gradient interference.

All 30 slots enter Dice BatchNorm in every cell, including zero-count slots; normalization couples the views during training. This population is held identical within the suite, but differs from historical 10/20/100-slot runs. Identical parameters do not make those older runs fully matched.

Action-aware scoring is now also available on uniform summaries. Improvements over old uniform10 may come from that scorer rather than task-selective compression; new UU is the necessary replacement control.

Feedback stratification changes active slot occupancies and view geometry. True versus rotated membership in round 1 provides only single-seed local evidence about semantics; this suite does not newly isolate semantic grouping from generic two-stratum partitioning.

The UF assignment is motivated by observed validation outcomes, so confirmation is conditional and adaptively selected. Task prevalence, sparse auxiliary labels, one pass and one common seed may drive observed differences.

Auxiliary labels reflect user/category/brand matches within 24 hours, not advertisement-specific conversion. official_offline feedback may be immature at online prediction time. No production causal-availability or online effectiveness claim follows.

Equal forward calculations and capacity do not guarantee equal backward cost or convergence: task-dependent gradients and kernel execution must be measured. Older total inference time includes loading, whereas p50/p95 are model-only batch latencies.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: This proposal includes four fully counted cells (one candidate, three controls), each from scratch with seed20262027 and unchanged one-pass full protocol. No local training or installation. After host forward/backward, masking and finite-output checks, run UU first for reliability, then UF, FF and FU as listed in proposal. Stop/review on a failed prerequisite, charged failure or cap; do not silently omit controls or duplicate unknown execution states. Reserve at least 12 further frozen full-unit slots (~5776s at estimated unit,14441s at hard per-trial cap) for three-seed paired confirmation of all four cells if host phase/seed authorization and remaining budget permit. With the present fixed-seed contract these repetitions are future plans, not executable overrides. Any extra semantic-routing, normalization or gradient control needs a new prospective proposal and charged cost.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Keep at least 15000s (and whatever the host explicitly requires) for final reference/candidate assessment, reproducibility and audit; this phase requests no held-out scoring. Freeze chosen source/config/checkpoint hashes, references, ablations, seeds and assessment commands before any later authorized withheld run. Closed outcomes must never reenter open memory or selection. Three-seed estimates and assessment totals are reservations, not charged completed measurements.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Respect unchanged deadline1794132148.3455288, per-trial cap1203.3689693547785, resource ledger and information boundary. Do not launch an experiment if it cannot fit with attribution/assessment reserve; never raise caps or alter the frozen recipe. All four cells, diagnostics, failures and repairs consume budget. This turn ends after source and proposal static checks: phase=propose prohibits training. If UF fails both matched criteria or is dominated, preserve that result and keep the click incumbent; a promising partial result may justify a later discriminating proposal, never an automatic scientific success.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Local round-1 true-versus-rotated grouping improved auxiliary discrimination while losing click. Pinned INFNet forward explicitly uses task-specific masked hubs, motivating a task-access contrast rather than another shared grouping. Declared use in the preceding round did not establish an INFNet effect.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Task-dependent access to uniform versus auxiliary-union stratified compression, with a common target/action scorer; no task hub parameters or broadcast layers.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Fixed task-to-view routing across arithmetic temporal summaries replaces task-specific sequence projection and iterative hub aggregation/broadcast. Only pinned benchmark code inspected; original paper remains unaudited.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: UF must improve auxiliary AUC over UU and click over FF; FU dominance or homogeneous dominance leaves the task-alignment adaptation unsupported.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Retrieved compression and history/task cards plus benchmark description were inspected. The local tradeoff is task-dependent loss of feedback association; flattening the whole history would introduce substantial projection/interaction changes and confound that contrast.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No history flattening tokenizer or paired-stream mixing; two explicit arithmetic views and one shared scorer. Original UniMixer paper/code not audited here.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: This suite cannot establish or refute flattening benefits; a later capacity/cost-matched replacement would be required.
